title: On spherical Milnor Classifying Spaces I: differential geometry
summary: We compare the original product-subset diffeology on the Milnor join of Magnot--Watts with the locally finite final diffeology on a signed spherical model. The canonical squaring map from the spherical space to the Magnot--Watts join is smooth, whereas the positive square-root section is generally not; we also construct a different smooth injection from the locally finite simplicial model whose inverse is not smooth.
